visitors.title: Visitors
visitors.caption: The site's own count, from every source, since {{date}}. No cookies, no personal data.
visitors.captionOff: The site's own count, from every source. No cookies, no personal data.
visitors.emptyHint: The counter runs on leadawaker.com only, never on app.leadawaker.com. Once it is live there, every visit shows up here: Google, AI assistants like ChatGPT and Perplexity, LinkedIn, direct.
visitors.directHint: A typed address, a bookmark, an app, or a link that hides where it came from
visitors.ownVisits: Your own visits count too. Open this once in each browser you use and it leaves you out:

search.title: Google Search
search.caption: From Search Console, {{start}} to {{end}}. Google runs about two days behind.
search.none: Google did not show the site in this period.
search.queriesHidden: Google hides searches that are too rare, so the totals can be higher than this list.
search.queriesEmpty: None to list. Google hides searches that are too rare to show.

unavailable.no_credentials: The server has no Google login, so Search Console cannot be read.
unavailable.no_access: The server's Google login has expired or has no Search Console access.
unavailable.error: Google did not answer. Try again in a few minutes.
unavailable.fix: To fix it, sign in again on the server (gcloud auth application-default login) with the Search Console scope.

index.title: In Google's index
index.caption: Each page of your sitemap, and whether Google has it
index.loading: Asking Google about each page. This takes about 20 seconds the first time.
index.sitemapPending: waiting for Google to read it
index.sitemapMissing: No sitemap has been sent to Google.

reason.unknown: Google has not seen it yet
reason.duplicate: Seen as a copy of another page

index.otherHostsHint: These are on your domain but are not the public site. The app and the API now tell Google to stay out, so they should drop off over the coming weeks.
